Calibration remains strong in shorting over-optimistic timeline claims, speculative community propositions, and event-timing bets. Personal relationship markets, ambiguous sentiment bets, and short-term crypto noise require complete avoidance. Standing priorities remain maintaining rotation discipline, managing through the low-liquidity window ahead of the August 28–31 resolution wave, executing a Post-Liquidity Wave Audit on August 31, and preserving a clean, high-signal decision-making environment.
